body:
I found some nice bits along the trail and dried them. Later I put approx . 3g into my vape. Effects took 15 to 20 mins to set in, a bit of light headedness and an overall spaced out mind, interesting thoughts, note this is wild chamomile and not german or any other kind.  High lasted for about an hour and a half. Overall interesting experience, somewhat like a light mj buzz.  Will try again making a mix of wild chamomile, tea chamomile and some catmint.
